tip: Read the Kompass first: it gives you the key facts behind every question in this block.

exercises.title: Kompass: End of the GDR, reunification & remembrance
exercises.body: Reunification's mechanics: the DDR didn't merge with the BRD, its re-founded five Länder **joined** the Federal Republic (Beitritt, 03.10.1990), automatically entering the EU too. Cold-War geometry: DDR ∈ **Warschauer Pakt** (Soviet bloc) vs. BRD ∈ NATO. The DDR ran a **Planwirtschaft** and watched its people through the **Stasi**. Remembrance snapshots: **Stolpersteine** (brass cobblestones for Nazi victims), **17. Juni 1953** (crushed uprising), the DDR emblem (Hammer, Zirkel, Ährenkranz).

exercises.title: Kompass auf Deutsch: DDR-Ende, Wiedervereinigung & Erinnerung
exercises.body: 3. Oktober 1990: Deutsche Einheit, die 5 östlichen Länder (Brandenburg, Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt, Thüringen, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern) treten bei. „Die Wende“ = von der Diktatur zur Demokratie. Stolpersteine erinnern an die NS-Opfer.
